Warriors @ Spurs 6/10 8:30 - Curry out, Fox questionable, Spurs favored
Grizzlies @ Pelicans 4/10 7:00 - Edey out, Pelicans gutted, could stay close
Knicks @ Pacers 3/10 6:00 - Champs without Haliburton to face

games.notes: Curry out for Golden State, Fox and Vassell questionable for San Antonio. Wemby and the Spurs should handle a Curry-less Warriors team; likely comfortable, but Fox's status is worth checking.
Edey and Post out for Memphis; Murray, Trey Murphy and Missi out for New Orleans, Mathurin questionable. Two banged-up rosters, so it could stay closer than the records say.
Haliburton out and Nesmith questionable for Indiana. The defending champion Knicks should win without much drama, though the early tip and thin Pacers make it a skip.
Jalen Williams, Holmgren and Sorber out, Ajay Mitchell questionable for OKC; Ingram out for LA. A short-handed contender against a bad team, likely a Thunder win but a dull one.
Morant and Sharpe out for Portland, Achiuwa out for Sacramento. A young team against the league's worst; Blazers should win, not much to see.
Mobley out for Cleveland, Larsson doubtful for Miami, Klay probable. Two middling teams, close but forgettable.
Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. out for Utah, Smart suspended for Houston. Houston should win easily; likely blowout.
Flemings questionable for Atlanta; Powell and Swain questionable for Chicago. Mid team against a bad one, likely a Hawks win with little intrigue.
Banchero out and Suggs questionable for Orlando. Two struggling teams, one of the worst matchups of the night, skip it.
